parameters.jsCode:
const fromNode   = $input.item.json;
const fromNumber = fromNode.from_number;
const toNumber   = fromNode.to_number;

const reply = [
  '🤖 *Yahya Job Bot — Commands*',
  '',
  '*find [keywords]* — search LinkedIn',
  '  e.g. _find AI engineer_',
  '  e.g. _find data scientist in Nairobi_',
  '',
  '*top* — find top AI/ML jobs right now',
  '',
  '*apply [URL]* — analyze a job form & pre-fill answers',
  '  e.g. _apply https://jobs.company.com/apply/123_',
  '',
  '*help* — show this menu',
  '',
  'Search results: title, company, location & link.',
  'Apply guides go to your Google Sheet 📊 + back here.'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { reply, from_number: fromNumber, to_number: toNumber } }];

meta.description: Interactive WhatsApp job search + application bot. Commands: 'find [keywords]', 'find [keywords] in [location]', 'top', 'apply [URL]', 'help'. The 'apply' command calls the Job Application Form Filler workflow to analyze the form, pre-fill answers, and return a guide. SETUP: (1) Set Twilio credential on Send WhatsApp Reply node. (2) Activate this workflow and copy the webhook URL. (3) In Twilio console, paste URL into WhatsApp sandbox 'When a message comes in'. (4) Send 'join <sandbox-word>' to +1 415 523 8886 from your WhatsApp.
